## 關於![蘋果汁](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/9CqVayvc/images/8eab9e791759330c7343a38914edfb7b96a59342.png) ![辣椒植物](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/9CqVayvc/images/14c2753a6ddf163e121cdcd2cf5ab65ba63d639f.png)![糖果蘋果](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/9CqVayvc/images/9db2d9c50a1592789322f8b08a665361bc81a61f.png)![胡蘿蔔汁](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/9CqVayvc/images/877f969cfe414b1e4fcdf97ec0a2f708ef186dba.png)![檸檬草](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/9CqVayvc/images/44abb1f5634afad7bb0fe59366cce079b79b77d6.png)![辣味雞肉](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/9CqVayvc/images/a8ede3dce5ce485c7aad61916cf25e73e9362b79.png)![甜莓汁](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/9CqVayvc/images/edd9e68e31c750afddb34ab6695e11fb959e1474.png)![布朗尼](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/9CqVayvc/images/11047b20068c5c9e4a762faa78a66feba45169fe.png)![兔肉高湯](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/9CqVayvc/images/7f20ca794d98d71af3d91eb783595c0db6ed86b5.png)![西瓜汁](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/9CqVayvc/images/67ee446781cb3e0c3c3f064716bc8bb3833b9d6a.png)

本模組擴展了遊戲中的烹飪體驗，新增了多樣化的食物、飲品和植物供玩家探索、種植與享用。透過提供獨特且異國風情的物品，特別適合喜愛農耕與料理玩法的玩家。
